title: Initial consult
body:
## Subjective
58-year-old woman referred after screening mammogram showed a 3.1 cm right breast mass. Core biopsy confirmed invasive ductal carcinoma. No prior cancer history. Family history: mother with breast cancer in her 60s.

## Assessment
Invasive ductal carcinoma, right breast, clinical stage II. Receptors ER-/PR-/HER2 3+.

## Plan
- Staging CT chest/abdomen/pelvis and bone scan.
- Baseline echocardiogram before HER2-directed therapy.
- Discuss neoadjuvant chemotherapy with trastuzumab and pertuzumab.
- Refer to genetics for BRCA testing.
text:
Initial consult
## Subjective
58-year-old woman referred after screening mammogram showed a 3.1 cm right breast mass. Core biopsy confirmed invasive ductal carcinoma. No prior cancer history. Family history: mother with breast cancer in her 60s.

## Assessment
Invasive ductal carcinoma, right breast, clinical stage II. Receptors ER-/PR-/HER2 3+.

## Plan
- Staging CT chest/abdomen/pelvis and bone scan.
- Baseline echocardiogram before HER2-directed therapy.
- Discuss neoadjuvant chemotherapy with trastuzumab and pertuzumab.
- Refer to genetics for BRCA testing.
author: Dr. Rivera (Oncology)

title: Pathology summary
body: Core needle biopsy, right breast: invasive ductal carcinoma, grade 3. Receptors: ER-/PR-/HER2 3+ by IHC. Ki-67 35%. Lymphovascular invasion not identified on biopsy.
text:
Pathology summary
Core needle biopsy, right breast: invasive ductal carcinoma, grade 3. Receptors: ER-/PR-/HER2 3+ by IHC. Ki-67 35%. Lymphovascular invasion not identified on biopsy.
author: Dr. Rivera (Oncology)

title: Baseline echocardiogram
body: Transthoracic echo before trastuzumab. LVEF 64%. Normal wall motion. No valvular disease. Global longitudinal strain -20%. Cleared to start HER2-directed therapy with echo every 3 months.
text:
Baseline echocardiogram
Transthoracic echo before trastuzumab. LVEF 64%. Normal wall motion. No valvular disease. Global longitudinal strain -20%. Cleared to start HER2-directed therapy with echo every 3 months.
author: Dr. Chen (Cardiology)

title: Cycle 1 neoadjuvant therapy
body:
## Subjective
Starts cycle 1 of docetaxel, carboplatin, trastuzumab and pertuzumab (TCHP). Anxious but well informed.

## Plan
- Premedication per protocol.
- Growth factor support.
- Labs before each cycle.
text:
Cycle 1 neoadjuvant therapy
## Subjective
Starts cycle 1 of docetaxel, carboplatin, trastuzumab and pertuzumab (TCHP). Anxious but well informed.

## Plan
- Premedication per protocol.
- Growth factor support.
- Labs before each cycle.
author: Dr. Rivera (Oncology)

title: Cycle 3 check-in
body:
## Subjective
Mild fatigue and diarrhea grade 1, managed with loperamide. No neuropathy.

## Objective
Breast mass smaller on exam, now about 1.0 cm.

## Plan
Continue TCHP. Echo before cycle 4.

title: Echo before cycle 4
body: LVEF 58%, a small drop from baseline 64%. No symptoms of heart failure. Continue trastuzumab with routine cardiac monitoring every 3 months.

author: Dr. Chen (Cardiology)

title: Follow-up after cycle 4
body:
## Subjective
Completed cycle 4 of neoadjuvant therapy. Mild fatigue, no neuropathy. Appetite good. Asked whether any clinical trials could fit her after surgery.

## Assessment
Responding on exam. Ejection fraction stable on last echo.

## Plan
- Surgical consult after cycle 6.
- Review recruiting adjuvant trials near home.
- Repeat echo before surgery.

- Growth factor support.
- Labs before each cycle.

Continue TCHP. Echo before cycle 4.
